fields.label: Custom URL (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty for the official provider. Use for LiteLLM or self-hosted models.

fields.label: Heavy Model (optional)
fields.description: Used for import file analysis and summarization. Leave empty to use the base model.

fields.label: LLM API Key
fields.description: Required for Anthropic/OpenAI. Leave empty for Ollama (no key needed).

fields.label: OpenAI Key (Whisper)
fields.description: Separate OpenAI Whisper API key for voice transcription — required regardless of the main LLM provider above.

fields.label: Model Limits
fields.description: Controls model output size and request timeout

fields.label: Max Tokens
fields.description: Maximum output tokens per model response. GPT-5.5 supports up to 16,384. Higher values increase per-response cost.

fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Timeout for both LLM API calls and client site API calls.

fields.label: Session Limits
fields.description: Controls session token usage caps

fields.label: Warning at (est. Tokens)
fields.description: When estimated tokens exceed this, a warning is appended to the model's reply without stopping the session.

fields.label: Hard Cap at (est. Tokens)
fields.description: When exceeded, new messages are blocked and the user is asked to start a new session.

fields.label: Agent Loop
fields.description: Controls how many steps the AI agent can take per conversation turn

fields.label: Max Agent Iterations
fields.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per single chat message. Higher = can complete complex tasks but increases API cost and risk of retry loops.

fields.label: Output Truncation
fields.description: Controls how much data is sent back to the model and stored in logs

fields.label: Tool Result Max Chars
fields.description: Max characters from each tool result sent back to the model. Counts against context window.

fields.label: Log Truncation Limit
fields.description: Max characters stored per field in AI Action Log. Does not affect model quality — only audit storage.

fields.label: Error Message Limit
fields.description: Max characters for error messages stored in AI Task and AI Action Log.

fields.label: Error Display Limit
fields.description: Max characters for error messages returned to the model in tool results.

fields.label: Validation Error Limit
fields.description: Max characters for inline validation errors (link checks, mandatory checks).

fields.label: List & Query Limits
fields.description: Controls how many records are returned by read operations

fields.label: List Documents Max Limit
fields.description: Hard cap for list_documents tool — even if the model requests more.

fields.label: List Documents Default Limit
fields.description: Default limit when the model does not specify a limit.

fields.label: Client Get List Default
fields.description: Default limit for internal client.get_list calls not triggered by the model directly.

fields.label: Inspect Customizations Limit
fields.description: Max Custom Fields and Property Setters returned per query.

fields.label: Diagnose Permissions Limit
fields.description: Max roles and permission rules returned per query.

fields.label: List Client Sites Limit
fields.description: Max client sites returned by list_client_sites tool.

fields.label: Search Limits
fields.description: Controls search result counts

fields.label: Find Document Name Limit
fields.description: Max matches returned when searching for a document by filters.

fields.label: Search Past Tasks Limit
fields.description: Max past tasks returned by search_past_tasks tool.

fields.label: Search Templates Limit
fields.description: Max templates returned by search_templates tool.

fields.label: List Available Limit
fields.description: Max available artifacts shown in capture/template listing.

fields.label: List Artifact Types Limit
fields.description: Max DocTypes returned when listing all available artifact types.

fields.label: Options Display
fields.description: Controls how many options are shown for Link and Select fields

fields.label: Link Options Limit
fields.description: Max options returned for a Link field (e.g. Item Group, Warehouse).

fields.label: Available Options Shown
fields.description: Max options displayed inline when a Link field value is invalid.

fields.label: Select Options Shown
fields.description: Max Select field choices displayed inline in validation messages.

fields.label: Attachment Reading Limits
fields.description: Controls how much file content is sent to the model via chat attachments

fields.label: Max Rows per Sheet
fields.description: Max rows read from Excel/CSV attachments in chat. The import tool processes the full file without this limit.

fields.label: Max File Content Characters
fields.description: Max characters read from text file attachments in chat.

fields.label: Remote Import Limits
fields.description: Controls batch size, timeout, and approval thresholds for Remote Import

fields.label: Default Batch Size
fields.description: Default number of rows per batch in Remote Import.

fields.label: Import Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time for a background import job.

fields.label: Max Rows per Import
fields.description: Maximum rows allowed in a single import. Set 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Require Approval for Large Imports
fields.description: Create an AI Task for approval when import exceeds threshold.

fields.label: Large Import Threshold (rows)
fields.description: Row count above which import requires approval.
